name: io.github.moveinfra/eu-cloud-mcp
title: EU Cloud
description: Move off AWS, GCP, Azure: EU-owned alternatives, EU cloud prices, exit fees, Terraform lock-in scan.

tools.name: find_eu_alternative
tools.description: Which EU-owned cloud product (UpCloud, Scaleway, Hetzner, OVHcloud) replaces an AWS, Google Cloud, Azure or DigitalOcean service, and how hard the move is. Examples: "S3", "RDS", "EKS", "DynamoDB", "Cloud Run", "Cosmos DB".

tools.name: compare_eu_cloud_prices
tools.description: Monthly EUR list prices for the same server, database, Kubernetes and storage baskets on AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, UpCloud, Hetzner, Scaleway and OVHcloud, refreshed monthly from provider price APIs.

basket.description: Filter, e.g. "4 vCPU", "postgres", "kubernetes". Omit for all baskets

tools.name: estimate_cloud_exit_fees
tools.description: Egress cost of moving data out of AWS, Azure or Google Cloud at list price, whether the provider's exit program waives it and its conditions, and what the EU Data Act allows.

data_gb.description: Data to move, in GB (1 TB = 1000 GB)

tools.name: scan_terraform_lock_in
tools.description: Takes the contents of Terraform (.tf) files as text and lists the AWS, Google Cloud, Azure and DigitalOcean services used, how portable each is to EU-owned clouds, what replaces it, and an EU portability score. The text is scanned in memory and not stored. Remove secrets before sending.

terraform.description: Contents of one or more .tf files, joined
